data.body: A6-0b RED evidence before production edits: focused oracle collected and executed 9 tests; all 9 failed on absent behavior, not import/setup errors. Clean pre-epoch clone stayed on the old tip instead of adopting the rewritten epoch tip. Same-epoch divergence failed to make the remote event reachable. Local-ahead/missing-prior/corrupt/existing-epoch/fetch-failure cases lacked the required fetch/ref update and operator warning behavior. The moving-ref case remained on the old tip; its fixture now holds origin at the validated commit and moves only the remote-tracking ref at the reset seam. An ensure-script-only autodeploy diff did not select compose-up. No production file changed.
